scoring: A supported focus is a strict direct hit when all the required paragraphs are among the first k direct search results. Empty evidence lists do not earn a hit. Separate secondary analysis counts whether all targeted explanatory paragraphs were shown for the three scope or partial cases. Report candidate exposure for the three remaining unresolved controls without treating a ranked candidate as a verdict. The displayed Korean row is the unique output of the production preparer containing both its paragraph position and anchor.

mac-speed.note: Manufacturer's own comparative performance claim and maximum multipliers; no independent hardware testing.

mac-ports.note: Body gives the connector types, counts and front jack. Rear photograph caption locates Ethernet and HDMI with the rear Thunderbolt ports. Jack diameter was outside the preselected focus.

mac-neural.note: The specified announcement does not provide the 38-trillion figure.

mac-release.note: Apple dates the first wave, including the US, to November 8. The story says November 9 without naming a release market and also prints Korean prices. The announcement identifies no November 9 market; it does not establish a Korean market date.

happy-finland.note: The release states first place for seven consecutive years but does not supply the precise score.

happy-us.note: The release establishes first fall out of the top twenty and rank 23, but does not supply the precise score.

happy-korea.note: The release states over 140 countries but omits the exact denominator, South Korean score and rank.

happy-north.note: The release neither enumerates the countries surveyed nor discusses North Korea. Absence from this article does not establish exclusion from the survey.
